english.name: Poland Legal Apprenticeship Entrance Exam (Advocate and Legal Adviser)
english.fullName: Polish entrance exam for the advocate and legal adviser apprenticeships (egzamin wstępny na aplikację adwokacką i radcowską), in Polish

notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item used once in tests (pools exactly 4x each count). The real paper is 150 questions in 150 minutes (art. 75i Prawa o adwokaturze, 1 point each, 100 to pass); Tigertest models it at 50 questions at the same pace and the same two-thirds line: passPct 67 = ceil(0.67 x 50) = 34 of 50. Real items have three options (A, B, C); ours four (v1 engine). Categories follow the legal areas of art. 75a ust. 3 Prawa o adwokaturze and the 2026 wykaz aktów prawnych; the per-test split is Tigertest's own (the Ministry publishes no weights). Training: five topic sets 45601-45605 (36/28/56/36/44), dashboard 5 sets + 4 tests = 9 steps.
